findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 58 requests to 22 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

8 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), brandmetrics.com (Brandmetrics, audience measurement), dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), google-analytics.com (Google, analytics), parsely.com (Parse.ly, analytics), permutive.com (Permutive, advertising), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
1 cookies were set by third-party domains (23 cookies in total).
